//: How the people of this mod answer what the social layer tells them (15 §10 to §12), until minds and goals (09) do it for them. Each is a plain rule a mod may switch off with its rule group: set the setting `core:social_life` to false.
doc: The bundled answers to orders, calls for help and reports. On unless the setting `core:social_life` is false.

//: Do as ordered: an order kept is put in the plan. The AI's goal of the same name replaces this (09 §8.1).
doc: Puts the action an order says to do at the end of the plan of whoever kept it.
A servant that is no longer one drops what it was told to do.

//: The watch hears a call for help: a guard remembers it, where it came from and who called, for a goal to answer.
doc: A member of the watch who hears a call for help remembers it, as `core:help_called`, where it came from.
A member of the watch who hears someone shout for the watch remembers it as a call for help (`core:help_called`), where it came from, as `core:heed_help` does.

if: event.report and self.in_group('core:watch') and not is_null(about)
doc: A member of the watch who hears someone shout for the watch about someone adds what it was told of them to the watch's knowledge, as `core:pass_reports_to_the_watch` does for a report.

//: Calls for help are passed on, once: one of the townsfolk who hears one and is not played by anyone shouts for the watch (an alarm, which is not passed on again), so that a call reaches a watchman at twice the reach of a voice, and no further (D-948).
if: self.in_group('core:townsfolk') and not self.in_group('core:watch') and self.control != 'direct' and now() - self.var.called_out_at > 30
doc: One of the townsfolk not played by anyone who hears a call for help, and has not called out in the last half minute, shouts for the watch: an alarm, which the watch answers and the townsfolk do not pass on.

//: A guard told what someone saw passes it to the watch, so that every guard knows it (15 §9.2).
doc: A member of the watch who is told something adds it to the watch's knowledge.
